WHO WE ARE

Industrial Damper Valve Engineering & Manufacturing

Pune, Maharashtra, India • Heavy Industrial Process Solutions

Bellator Engineers specializes in the engineering and manufacturing of industrial damper valves for process applications. Our focus is on understanding application requirements and developing solutions suited to operating conditions, system specifications and industrial requirements.

ENGINEERING COLLABORATION

Bringing Damper Valve Engineering and Actuation Together

Bellator Engineers India Pvt. Ltd. specializes in the engineering and manufacturing of fabricated industrial damper valves for process and HVAC applications. Our approach focuses on application requirements, equipment specifications and industrial operating conditions.

Through our strategic partnership with Actuatech S.p.A., Italy, we combine damper valve engineering with actuator technology to support integrated solutions for compatible industrial applications.

Product configuration and actuator selection are considered according to application requirements, operating conditions and equipment specifications.

AERODYNAMIC AIR & GAS CONTROL

What We Do

Delivering precision damper valve engineering, 100% man-safe isolation, and aerodynamic air control across marine, power, and heavy industrial process sectors.

Safety 100% Man-Safe Isolation
Reliability Rugged & Long-Lasting
Performance Critical Process Duty

Diverter Dampers

Gas turbine (CCGT) exhaust diverters built for rapid cycle high temperatures, and zero leakage performance.

Learn More → BE60 Series

Poppet Damper Valves

High-speed pneumatic cycling with positive seal seats for regenerative thermal oxidizers (RTO), baghouses, and multi-compartment dust collection.

Learn More → BE80 Series

Guillotine Damper Valves

Heavy-duty slide gate delivering 100% man-safe seal air isolation, zero pressure drop, and rugged performance for utility boilers and cement kilns.

Learn More → BE90 Series

Butterfly Damper Valves

High-cycle flue gas isolation, minimal pressure drop, and quick quarter-turn pneumatic or electric actuation for boiler exhausts and process lines.

Learn More → BE10 Series

Double Disc Gate Valves

100% man-safe zero-leakage guillotine with pressurized seal air chamber for high temperature ducts and coal pulverizers.

Learn More → BE20 Series
